description: Lowest current US self-pay prices of a GLP-1 medication, ranked by cost per 30 days. Accepts a brand (Zepbound, Wegovy), an ingredient (semaglutide returns its brands and the compounded list), or a compounded product (compounded tirzepatide). Only prices that state the supply they buy are ranked. Returns each seller, product, cost per 30 days, the seller's own price wording, the check date, the seller's source page, whether GLPcompare may earn a referral commission, and the GLPcompare page with every price and its terms.

limit.description: How many prices to return per list. Defaults to 10.

medication.description: A brand, an ingredient or a compounded product, e.g. "Zepbound", "semaglutide", "compounded tirzepatide".

name: find_glp1_prices
title: Find GLP-1 prices
